player_prompt.intro: Waxaad ku ciyaareysaa Blackjack ganacsadaha. Hadafkaagu waa inaad ku dhowaato 21 sida ugu macquulsan adigoon dhaafin. Marka aad soo jeesato, dooro '[Hit]' inaad soo jiidato kaar kale ama '[Stand]' inaad haysato. J/Q/K = 10 dhibcood; A = 11 ama 1, hadba midka ugu fiican.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Waxqabadka aan ansax ahayn. Isticmaal "[Hit]" ama "[Stand]".

game_message.all_complete: === Dhamaan {num_hands} gacmaha oo dhameystiran === Guul: {wins}, Khasaaro: {losses}, Isku aadka: {draws}

outcome.game_over: Ciyaarta ayaa soo dhamaatay. Dhibcaha ugu dambeeya: Dealer: {losses}, Adiga: {wins}, Saamiyada: {draws}
